page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4543 / H.
June 1, 1933. 7/6/33

At 2.30 p.m. May 31, Mr. T.I. Givens, Officer
i/c Special Branch, and Supt. Tan Shao Liang had an
interview with General Wen Hung En, Chief of the Public
Safety Bureau at his office in the city and brought to
his attention in a friendly manner a number of instances
in which employees or agents of the Chinese Authorities
had taken action in Communist cases in the Settlement
without the co-operation of the Municipal Police under
circumstances calculated to lead to abuses and to the
breaking of the confidence of the public in the Municipal
Police and Public Safety Bureau.

The Officer i/c Special Branch emphasized the
appreciation of the Municipal Police of the assistance
rendered by the Chinese Authorities in checking Communist
activities in the Settlement, but explained that the
object in view would be prejudiced rather than assisted
by the adoption of illegal methods.

General Wen thanked Mr. Givens for the information,
and promised to take measures to ensure that the abuses
mentioned would be discontinued. General Wen added that
the Public Safety Bureau is perfectly satisfied with
the co-operation given by the Police, and that any
departure from the present methods would injure the
prestige of the Public Safety Bureau and consequently
could not be tolerated.

Full details of the cases brought to the attention
of General Wen are given in files Nos. D.4389, D.4395,
D.4391 and D.4375.

〔此处转录不清：左下角签名及印章、右下角签名及“OFFICER I/C SP. BR.”字样〕

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别科登记处
编号 D 4543 / H.
1933年6月1日。7/6/33

5月31日下午2时30分，特别科主管 T.I. Givens 先生与谭绍良（Tan Shao Liang）警司在市内公安局局长温宏恩（Wen Hung En）将军的办公室与其进行了会晤，并以友好的方式提请其注意若干事例：在这些事例中，中国当局的雇员或代理人在未与工部局警务处合作的情况下，于租界内处理共产党案件，其情形足以导致滥用职权，并破坏公众对工部局警务处及公安局的信任。

特别科主管强调，工部局警务处对中国当局在遏制租界内共产党活动方面所提供的协助表示赞赏，但解释说，采用非法手段不仅无助于实现既定目标，反而会损害该目标。

温将军感谢 Givens 先生提供的信息，并承诺采取措施以确保上述滥用职权的行为得以停止。温将军补充说，公安局对警务处给予的合作完全满意，任何偏离现行做法的行为都将损害公安局的威望，因此是不能容忍的。

向温将军提请注意的各案件的详细情况见档案编号 D.4389、D.4395、D.4391 和 D.4375。

〔此处转录不清：左下角签名及印章、右下角签名及“OFFICER I/C SP. BR.”字样〕
